name: examleaf-source-ingest
purpose: Extract owned/permitted PDFs with page provenance
outputs: Native-text JSON; source SHA; flagged pages
steps: Confirm rights | Extract native text per page | Store file hash and page indices | Flag empty text and formulas/figures for visual review; never implicitly OCR
acceptance: Synthetic PDF extraction test; reject missing rights for release
fallback: Return extraction blockers; request a better original; OCR is an explicit reviewed exception
cost: Local CPU; zero model calls
status: Native-text CLI tested on synthetic PDF; textbook/syllabus ingestion not end-to-end validated

name: examleaf-curriculum-map
purpose: Map concepts to board, class, medium and academic year
outputs: Versioned coverage map with unresolved items
steps: Record board division/year | Match terms and question scope | Distinguish prerequisite from assessed content | Have academic reviewer approve coverage
acceptance: Wrong-year and unsupported-coverage negative fixtures
fallback: Mark mapping pending; never infer syllabus authority from a publisher statement
cost: Small retrieval/model job; cache by syllabus hash

name: examleaf-claim-research
purpose: Create an attributable claim and worked-answer ledger
steps: Identify every teaching claim | Attach locator/rights and assumptions | Independently solve examples | Separate source wording from new inference
acceptance: Unknown source ID rejected locally; hallucinated citation is a hard failure
fallback: Hold script at review_pending
cost: Research token budget; retrieve relevant spans, not whole books repeatedly

name: examleaf-lesson-plan
purpose: Scope a coherent approximately ten-minute lesson
steps: Choose one target capability | Add prerequisite repair | Worked to faded to independent sequence | Estimate rather than fake audio duration
acceptance: Objectives assessed by a fresh item; all claims traceable
fallback: Split over-dense chapter into two lessons
cost: One structured planning call; no media generation

name: examleaf-super-teacher
purpose: Write warm, exact, conversational narration
outputs: Spoken script separate from display text and directions
steps: Begin with a genuine question | Explain the decision behind each step | Avoid fake listening/persona history | End with independently checkable capability
acceptance: No genius/easy/guaranteed marks language; terminology preserved
fallback: Return missing prerequisites; do not cover gaps with motivational filler
cost: One draft plus bounded repair; not a fresh long prompt per scene

name: examleaf-analogy-humour
purpose: Use relevant stories and optional concept-linked humour
steps: Map each analogy element | State boundary | Check misconception risk | Delete a joke that delays or distorts the explanation
acceptance: Reject electrons wanting/lazy as causal accounts; reject shaming and fabricated stats
fallback: Use direct explanation; zero jokes is valid
cost: Small editorial pass; no separate generative clip required

name: examleaf-interaction-design
purpose: Create age-appropriate question/pause/feedback loops
outputs: Cue[]; answer-hidden periods; hints and answer keys
steps: Select predict/recall/write/draw/solve task | Specify output | Add honest wait or pause-video cue | Reveal conditionally | Provide a repair
acceptance: Question cannot have answer_visible=true; maintain contiguous cues
fallback: Use learner-controlled pause for work exceeding a brief hold
cost: No compulsory API calls; validated data

name: examleaf-science-math
purpose: Validate derivations, domains and examples
steps: Check domain/assumptions | Derive symbolically | Numeric cross-check away from singularities | Verify exclusions and units where applicable
acceptance: Chain-rule positive/negative tests and parameter-contract tests
fallback: Reject unsupported template rather than evaluate arbitrary supplied code
cost: Local computation; expert checks remain
status: Bounded chain-rule validator tested; not a general theorem prover

name: examleaf-science-physics
purpose: Validate physical models before drawing
steps: Declare idealization | Solve analytic/numerical model | Check limits/conservation/signs | Drive diagram and graph from same data
acceptance: RC initial condition, tau, monotonicity, KVL and ODE agreement
fallback: Switch to approved static explanation if model not validated
cost: Local CPU; cache solution by parameters
status: RC analytic/SciPy cross-check tested; broader models proposed

name: examleaf-science-chemistry
purpose: Validate molecular identity and counting
steps: Parse approved structures | Verify atom/charge ledger | Hold formulas fixed | Check condition/mechanism claims separately
acceptance: RDKit molecule/count and incorrect coefficient tests
fallback: Stop unknown molecule/template; do not treat balance as feasibility
cost: Local RDKit; expert review for chemistry reasoning
status: Bounded H2/O2/H2O count checks tested; mechanisms not implemented

name: examleaf-science-biology
purpose: Check explicit biological states and probabilities
steps: Declare model | Check counts/direction/compartments | Distinguish probability from guaranteed outcome | Require subject review
acceptance: Aa×Aa probabilities and complete-dominance caveat tests
fallback: Use approved diagram with unresolved process marked pending
cost: Mostly local rules plus expert review
status: Single-locus probability model tested; anatomy/process validators proposed

name: examleaf-storyboard-route
purpose: Route each scene by its teaching and accuracy need
steps: Classify equation/graph/process/illustration | Default deterministic for science | Select one representation | Attach source/asset IDs | Estimate cost before generation
acceptance: Unsupported subject-kind combination rejected; generated diagram routing rejected
fallback: Approved static SVG component before free-form generated animation
cost: One bounded planning pass; cheap deterministic routing

name: examleaf-svg-scenes
purpose: Render tested scientific 2D fixtures
steps: Validate inputs | Evaluate explicit model time | Lay out by aspect | Generate frame stream | Probe final media
acceptance: Eight real media fixtures; bounds and math model linkage
fallback: Fail non-supported templates; no silent crop
cost: CPU; actual preview benchmarks provided
status: Implemented and tested for four bounded fixtures

name: examleaf-manim-scenes
purpose: Produce specialist equation/geometry inserts
outputs: Transparent or opaque insert plus manifest
steps: Choose CE-only component | Bind stable symbol IDs | Render pinned version | Verify each transformation and units | Export and hash
acceptance: Golden equation/domain fixtures; frame compare; not executed here
fallback: SVG fallback if it accurately represents the concept
cost: Specialist render cost; reuse approved inserts

name: examleaf-web-composition
purpose: Compose full lessons in the selected browser engine
inputs: Approved scene media + voice timing + design tokens
steps: Use one engine | Vendor approved fonts/assets | Use seekable frame time | Insert pauses and captions | Export measured timeline
acceptance: Same four golden fixtures must pass chosen engine; no local engine benchmark yet
fallback: Keep portable scene/asset model; native SVG proof remains reference
cost: Renderer infrastructure; Remotion eligibility may add licensing

name: examleaf-blender-scenes
purpose: Author selective spatial scientific assets
inputs: Reviewed spatial model + asset licence ledger
dependencies: Pinned Blender; optional isolated MCP authoring
steps: Build from validated geometry/data | Record units/camera | Review topology/orientation | Headless render approved script only
acceptance: No exposed MCP port; no production secrets; annotated turntable inspection
fallback: Use 2D diagram when spatial value is not demonstrated
cost: High setup/render cost; opt-in only

name: examleaf-molecule-scenes
purpose: Draw approved structures and reaction states
steps: Keep atom IDs | Generate coordinates | Apply labelled conventions | Animate approved state changes | Mark schematic/not-to-scale
acceptance: Valence/charge/map/condition checks; human reaction review
fallback: Static state sequence rather than invented mechanism
cost: Local 2D cheap; 3D only when useful

name: examleaf-biology-scenes
purpose: Animate approved biological process states
steps: Keep landmarks persistent | Show stages separately | Verify counts and direction | Reflow for phone | Supply still exam diagram
acceptance: State-transition/count invariants and anatomy reviewer approval
fallback: Hold a reviewed static diagram with verbal explanation
cost: Asset authoring dominates initial cost

name: examleaf-voice-direction
purpose: Translate Super Teacher writing into controlled delivery
outputs: Plain spoken segments; editorial tags; pronunciation map
dependencies: Super Teacher contract; provider capability map
steps: Separate formula display from pronunciation | Choose steady/curious/deliberate/light/reassuring | Add pedagogical silence outside TTS | Mark critical terms
acceptance: No spoken stage directions; unit/Greek/fraction pronunciation audit
fallback: Rewrite ambiguous spoken text before regenerating voice
cost: No required media call; reduces repeat synthesis

name: examleaf-voice-synthesis
purpose: Generate and cache narration with explicit spend
inputs: Voice spec + approved text + model/voice rights
dependencies: Chosen TTS API; secret store; VoiceProvider
steps: Estimate/reserve cost | Hash text+voice+model+settings | Reuse asset | Submit once/persist job ID | Inspect duration and listen
acceptance: Mock/fail-closed adapter locally; one separate live Runway audition recorded
fallback: Auth/quota error stops job; never silently switch voice
cost: Pay per generated character; regenerate only changed segments
status: Packaged remote adapter unimplemented; standalone live speech probe separate

name: examleaf-alignment-localize
purpose: Align final audio and re-author language variants
steps: Align against actual waveform | Flag missing/changed words | Re-time semantic events | Reflow translated labels | Review native pronunciation
acceptance: Timestamp range/ordering validator tested; actual forced alignment not integrated
fallback: Manual critical-event timing; do not divide duration equally by word count
cost: Alignment plus localization review cost; TTS regenerated only per changed language

name: examleaf-render-batch
purpose: Render jobs with cache, budgets and bounded workers
steps: Validate before spend | Lock job | Render temp output | Probe/hash | Atomic publish to review area | Rejoin existing jobs after interruption
acceptance: Two-worker eight-file run; cache reuse; corrupted output repair policy
fallback: At most two failed repair attempts then human escalation
cost: Actual CPU measurements; local proof not cloud-priced
status: Local batch/cache/atomic output tested; distributed queue proposed

name: examleaf-visual-qa
purpose: Check frame content and accessibility
dependencies: SVG bounds; Playwright; human frame inspection
steps: Check graph axes/units | Compare model state and cue | Check safe areas/contrast | Inspect answer-hidden period | Review phone layout
acceptance: Bounds tests and regression for RC tau cue; full overlap/phone study pending
fallback: Block critical errors; no generative repaint of equation
cost: Automated preflight plus human visual review

name: examleaf-audio-caption-qa
purpose: Validate media timing, audio and subtitles
steps: Check streams/duration | Confirm speech against transcript | Check clipping/loudness | Align captions/reveals | Listen to complete output
acceptance: Real probe + synthetic WAV mux/mismatch tests; pronunciation not automatically certified
fallback: Return to narration source; do not caption an ASR error as correct
cost: Small compute; full-listen time budgeted

name: examleaf-release-review
purpose: Enforce academic and final-video approval
dependencies: Approval model; future authenticated review service
steps: Match approval to artifact hash | Require academic approval | Require full-video production review | Confirm rights/language/syllabus | Release only approved files
acceptance: Local release command blocks all silent previews; forged role auth not solved by JSON
fallback: Any changed critical artifact invalidates approval
cost: Mandatory reviewer time; not replaced by LLM vote
status: Local policy tests pass; identity-authenticated approval service not implemented

name: examleaf-reel-repurpose
purpose: Create one complete 20–60-second explanation
steps: Select independent learning payoff | Retain assumptions | Write truthful hook | Recompose vertical | One matching CTA | Review as standalone lesson
acceptance: ShortSpec rejects crop strategy and durations out of range
fallback: Produce fewer useful Shorts rather than cutting arbitrary segments
cost: Reuse expensive assets; new editorial approval still required

name: examleaf-thumbnail-package
purpose: Create truthful title/cover/package
inputs: Approved lesson, concept and brand tokens
outputs: Title options; editable SVG cover; description
dependencies: Brand assets; optional reviewed image service
steps: Choose readable focal point | Use real concept/diagram | Avoid fake percentages | Show correct free/paid destination | Check small-size readability
acceptance: No false marks claims; no source diagrams made incorrect to increase clicks
fallback: Simple deterministic type/diagram cover
cost: Near-zero render cost; optional generated illustration capped

name: examleaf-observability-cost
purpose: Track cost, failures and throughput
dependencies: SQLite cents ledger now; Postgres later
steps: Reserve before submitting | Store actual cost | Record cache/human repair | Alert cap | Reconcile unknown job before retry
acceptance: Atomic reservation and idempotency tests
fallback: Freeze generation when invoice/cost state is unresolved
cost: Local metrics; avoid logging confidential prompts
status: Local cents ledger tested; provider reconciliation proposed

name: examleaf-skills-security
purpose: Audit third-party Skills, plugins and MCP
dependencies: Static review; dependency audit; sandbox policy
steps: Confirm publisher | Read scripts/hooks | Inspect licence | Check secrets/network/files | Pin exact commit/version | Test negative cases in isolation
acceptance: Reject curl|sh, unauthenticated network execution and auto-install escalation
fallback: Do not install; use direct verified library calls
cost: One-time audit plus upgrade revalidation; not full automatic security proof

name: examleaf-learning-evaluation
purpose: Measure actual learning and calibrated confidence
steps: Predefine outcomes | Use fresh immediate/delayed items | Record prior knowledge | Compare variants fairly | Report uncertainty
acceptance: No fabricated effect size or claim that watch time proves learning
fallback: Keep design provisional until appropriate data exists
cost: Human research time; no emotion surveillance

name: examleaf-asset-library
purpose: Manage reusable verified assets and branding
steps: Record provenance | Tag scientific scope | Hash approved revision | Record licence/attribution | Reuse only in matching conditions
acceptance: Generated assets must include provider/model/job metadata
fallback: Unconfirmed rights remain quarantined
cost: High first-use effort; very low amortized reuse cost

name: examleaf-selective-generation
purpose: Procure optional non-authoritative images/clips
inputs: Approved scene purpose + provider capability + cap
dependencies: Higgsfield or Runway adapter; never required for core science
steps: Confirm generated-media value | Keep equations/labels out | Estimate/reserve | Submit once | Persist/rejoin job | Reject scientific distortions
acceptance: PendingAdapter raises; no mocked success; timeout does not trigger duplicate paid jobs
fallback: Use licensed/owned/deterministic illustration or omit clip
cost: Spend bounded per scene; zero generated seconds is allowed
